name: browser-check
description: Inspect, operate, and diagnose web pages in ego lite (a Chromium browser on the user's PC kept for agents, signed in to the user's sites) — on the PC directly, or from a server over ssh through a non-elevated relay on the PC. One command on the Bash path: `browser-check look <url>` returns the page text, a capture, errors and the requests sent; `run` for scripts, `api` for function help. Captures work while ego is minimized or closed. Korean natural-language trigger: "화면 확인해 봐", "CSS 깨졌는지 봐", "콘솔 에러 봐".
